title: MapKey::deserialize_bool parses a key from a UTF-8 continuation byte, building an invalid &str in safe code
author: mblauberg
body_preview: `MapKey::deserialize_bool` consumes the key's first byte with `next_char()` and, when it is neither `t` nor `f`, calls `read.parse_str()` from the following byte.
